links.comparator_used: Same LLMs (Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Llama 3 70B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B) answering USMLE questions without SCAI knowledge graph augmentation
links.outcome: Accuracy on text-only USMLE sample questions (Steps 1, 2 CK, 3; n=313); incorrect responses counted as confabulations
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 90.7% to 97.1% (Gemini), 82.4% to 92.0% (Llama 3 70B), and 55.3% to 81.8% (DeepSeek-R1-Distill); Copilot changed from 93.6% to 94.2% (not significant). Gains were significant for Gemini, Llama 3 70B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill on all three steps. Best single result: Llama 3 70B plus SCAI on Step 3, 121/123 (98.4%).
links.quote: Across 313 items, accuracy increased from 90.7% to 97.1% for Gemini, 82.4% to 92.0% for Llama 3 70B, and 55.3% to 81.8% for DeepSeek-R1-Distill; Copilot changed from 93.6% to 94.2%.

design_hint: knowledge graph retrieval grounding added to existing LLMs
